allowed.reason: Compares what the user typed with the agreement's shortcut answer; the text is user input.
Matches the platform's Build.MANUFACTURER and Build.BRAND values against the blocked vendor.
Decodes the native payload's wire format, whose flags are spelt 1 or true.
Preserves machine-facing diagnostic markers verbatim before localization; these evidence-boundary markers must not be translated.
Parses stable full/scoped inventory tokens in Dangerous Apps summaries so dynamic counts can be rendered with localized resources.
Maps stable detector UI titles, statuses and complete summary sentences to Android resources at the localization boundary; unknown diagnostic text passes through unchanged.
Parses stable network status and row-label tokens emitted by the network presentation model so dynamic counts and routes can be localized.
Parses stable runtime, Play Integrity, LSPosed, virtualization and signal-noun summaries into localized resources while retaining dynamic values.
Parses stable system, SELinux, mount, SU, custom-ROM and package-history summary formats to localize UI copy without changing evidence values.
Lays out the text it renders: it skips a detail equal to its headline and puts a short single-line detail beside its value. The choices change layout, not meaning.
Maps the summary and contribution keys of the bundled contributors asset to string resources and roles; the keys are identifiers the asset defines.
